profile_text: As a leading car dealership in Düsseldorf, Germany, this company specializes in providing a diverse range of new and used vehicles to its customers, driving its remarkable 167.9% growth since the baseline. With a focus on meeting the evolving needs of the automotive market, its sales operations have expanded significantly, now employing 509 people in 2024. This growth trajectory has earned the company a "Scaler" category designation, reflecting its rapid expansion and increasing market presence.
